'''Wunka'''<ref name="beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref> was an [[Ewok]] from [[Bright Tree Village]] on the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. During the [[Battle of Endor]], Wunka and the other Ewoks sided with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> Wunka and [[Widdle Warrick]]<ref name="beware" /> aided the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] in capturing [[All Terrain Scout Transport|AT-ST walker]] [[Tempest Scout 2]] and turning it against the [[Galactic Empire|Empire's]] forces.<ref name="ROTJ" />
